sourceRowSelection: All rows whose old or current owner is unit 9; no downsampling
coordinateProjection: Subtract saved designStartM, then dot with saved tangent/frameU/frameV; metres to millimetres only for transverse axes
inference: Dashed current axis beyond validated intervals is extrapolation, not measured support
timingScope: Single paired full classification-function calls; excludes source/model load and artifact export
uncertainty: No confidence interval; one paired run
